verdict.rationale: Default DDoS protection and WAF are a fair question for a global cloud/PaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions DDoS mitigation or a web application firewall. The global Anycast routing, egress policies and hardware-isolated VMs it does describe are adjacent features, not request-level attack filtering, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
